title: Pani pilao
body:
pani pilao sabeelein lagao
<<DIVIDER>>
pani piyo to yaad karo pyaas imam ki
pyason sabeelein hai ye shaheedon ke naam ki
<<DIVIDER>>
mohamed ka pyasa nawasa hai ye
ali aur zahra ka pyara hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kayi roz ka haye tashnadahan hai
musafir hai aur ye ghareebul watan hai
ke toote dilon ka sahara hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyare nabi ki pyari nishani
usay maar daalegi tashna dahani
mohamed ki aankhon ka taara hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
pilaye jo qatil ko sharbat ke saaghar
pilayega jo hashr mein jaam e kausar
usi sher e hyder ka beta hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo cheh maah ka asghar e bezaban hai
sakina si masoom tashna dahan hai
muslamano hum sab ka maula hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
safar ki aziyat uthayi hai is ne
ghareebon ki basti basayi hai is ne
madine se mehman aaya hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
karo pesh isko khiraaj e aqeedat
wo jis tashnalab ne bachayi shariyat
mohamed ki godhi ka paala hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
adaa ki shahdat ne ye shamdani
bujhi hauze kausar pe tashna dahani
zafar aur amjad ka nauha hai ye
pani pilao...
author: Zafar
